network-quality.title: Network Quality
network-quality.description: Let your end users or devices measure their connection to Cloudflare, including speed, latency, and jitter.
network-quality.greeting.title: Turn on the Network Quality API
network-quality.greeting.description: The Network Quality API lets clients measure the quality of their connection to the nearest Cloudflare data center, including download and upload speed, latency, and jitter. Only authorized clients can run Network Quality tests on behalf of your Cloudflare account.
network-quality.greeting.no_permission: You need the Network Quality Edit permission to turn on the Network Quality API.
network-quality.usage.no_permission.desc: You need the Account Analytics Read permission to view Network Quality usage.
network-quality.usage.chart.data.title: Bytes transferred
network-quality.usage.chart.data.tooltip: Bytes transferred by requests made with authorization tokens issued for your account. The transfer direction (egress or ingress) is reported from Cloudflare's point of view.
network-quality.usage.chart.data.empty: No bytes transferred in this time range.
network-quality.usage.chart.requests.too: Requests made with authorization tokens issued for your account. The transfer direction (egress or ingress) is reported from Cloudflare's point of view. Requests with no payload don't transfer any data.
network-quality.usage.chart.requests.emp: No requests in this time range.
network-quality.usage.locations.title: Location distribution
network-quality.usage.locations.tooltip: Cloudflare data centers that served requests made with authorization tokens issued for your account.
network-quality.usage.locations.empty: No requests in this time range.
network-quality.usage.locations.empty_by: No bytes transferred in this time range.
network-quality.settings.enabled.label: Network Quality API
network-quality.settings.enabled.descrip: Controls whether the Network Quality API is enabled for this account.
network-quality.settings.enabled.no_perm: You need the Network Quality Edit permission to change this setting.
network-quality.settings.enabled.protect: The Network Quality API can't be turned off for this account because it runs speed.cloudflare.com.
network-quality.settings.update_error: Unable to update the Network Quality API setting
Turn off the Network Quality API?
This account will no longer be able to use the Network Quality API, including the issuance of client authorization tokens.
